import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency, pointbiserialr

# --- Phase 3 Cleaning and Feature Engineering ---
print("--- 1. Data Cleaning and Preparation ---")

# Coerce 'TotalCharges' to numeric, creating NaNs for empty strings
df['TotalCharges'] = pd.to_numeric(df['TotalCharges'], errors='coerce')

# Check for NaNs and their correspondence with tenure=0
nan_total_charges = df[df['TotalCharges'].isnull()]
print(f"Found {len(nan_total_charges)} rows with null TotalCharges.")
if all(nan_total_charges['tenure'] == 0):
    print("All null TotalCharges correspond to tenure=0. Imputing with 0.")
    df['TotalCharges'].fillna(0, inplace=True)
else:
    print("Warning: Some null TotalCharges do not correspond to tenure=0.")

# Standardize 'SeniorCitizen' column
df['SeniorCitizen'] = df['SeniorCitizen'].map({0: 'No', 1: 'Yes'})
print("Standardized 'SeniorCitizen' column from 0/1 to 'No'/'Yes'.")

# Feature Engineering: tenure_group
bins = [0, 12, 24, 48, 72]
labels = ['0-12 Months', '13-24 Months', '25-48 Months', '49-72 Months']
# The right=False argument makes the bins inclusive of the left edge, which is what we want for tenure 0.
# We explicitly include -1 to make sure 0 is included in the first bin.
df['tenure_group'] = pd.cut(df['tenure'], bins=[-1, 12, 24, 48, 72], labels=labels)
print("Engineered 'tenure_group' feature.")

# Feature Engineering: num_optional_services
service_cols = ['OnlineSecurity', 'OnlineBackup', 'DeviceProtection', 'TechSupport', 'StreamingTV', 'StreamingMovies']
df['num_optional_services'] = (df[service_cols] == 'Yes').sum(axis=1)
print("Engineered 'num_optional_services' feature.")

# Create a numeric version of Churn for easy calculations
df['Churn_numeric'] = df['Churn'].apply(lambda x: 1 if x == 'Yes' else 0)
print("Created 'Churn_numeric' column for calculations.")
print("-" * 40 + "\n")


# --- Overall & Baseline Metrics ---
print("--- 2. Overall & Baseline Metrics ---")
print(f"Total Customers: {len(df)}")
churn_rate = df['Churn_numeric'].mean()
print(f"Overall Churn Rate: {churn_rate:.4f}")
print("-" * 40 + "\n")


# --- Univariate Analysis ---
print("--- 3. Univariate Analysis ---")
numeric_cols = ['tenure', 'MonthlyCharges', 'TotalCharges', 'num_optional_services']
categorical_cols = [col for col in df.columns if df[col].dtype == 'object' and col not in ['customerID', 'Churn']]
# Also include tenure_group which is a categorical type
categorical_cols.append('tenure_group')

print("\n[Univariate] Numeric Column Distributions:")
for col in numeric_cols:
    print(f"\n--- Column: {col} ---")
    print(df[col].describe())
    print(f"Skewness: {df[col].skew():.4f}")

print("\n\n[Univariate] Categorical Column Distributions:")
for col in categorical_cols:
    print(f"\n--- Column: {col} ---")
    print((df[col].value_counts(normalize=True) * 100).round(2).to_string())
print("-" * 40 + "\n")


# --- Bivariate Analysis ---
print("--- 4. Bivariate Analysis: Feature vs. Churn ---")

# Categorical Features vs. Churn
print("\n[Bivariate] Churn Rate by Categorical Features:")
for col in categorical_cols:
    print(f"\n--- Churn Rate by {col} ---")
    grouped = df.groupby(col)['Churn_numeric'].agg(['mean', 'count'])
    grouped.rename(columns={'mean': 'churn_rate'}, inplace=True)
    print(grouped)
    
    # Chi-squared test
    contingency_table = pd.crosstab(df[col], df['Churn'])
    chi2, p, dof, ex = chi2_contingency(contingency_table)
    print(f"Chi-squared test p-value: {p:.4g}") # Use 'g' for scientific notation on small p-values

# Numeric Features vs. Churn
print("\n\n[Bivariate] Numeric Feature Distribution by Churn:")
for col in numeric_cols:
    print(f"\n--- {col} Distribution by Churn ---")
    print(df.groupby('Churn')[col].describe())
    
    # Point-biserial correlation
    corr, p_value = pointbiserialr(df[col], df['Churn_numeric'])
    print(f"Point-biserial correlation with Churn: {corr:.4f} (p-value: {p_value:.4g})")


# Numeric vs. Numeric Correlation
print("\n\n[Bivariate] Correlation Matrix for Numeric Features:")
print(df[numeric_cols].corr())
print("-" * 40 + "\n")


# --- Multivariate Analysis ---
print("--- 5. Multivariate Analysis: High-Risk Segments ---")

# Interaction: Contract & Internet Service
print("\n[Multivariate] Churn Rate by Contract and Internet Service:")
multi_group1 = df.groupby(['Contract', 'InternetService'])['Churn_numeric'].agg(['mean', 'count'])
multi_group1.rename(columns={'mean': 'churn_rate'}, inplace=True)
print(multi_group1)

# Interaction: Tenure Group & Tech Support
print("\n[Multivariate] Churn Rate by Tenure Group and Tech Support:")
multi_group2 = df.groupby(['tenure_group', 'TechSupport'])['Churn_numeric'].agg(['mean', 'count'])
multi_group2.rename(columns={'mean': 'churn_rate'}, inplace=True)
print(multi_group2)

# Interaction: Paperless Billing & Payment Method
print("\n[Multivariate] Churn Rate by Paperless Billing and Payment Method:")
multi_group3 = df.groupby(['PaperlessBilling', 'PaymentMethod'])['Churn_numeric'].agg(['mean', 'count'])
multi_group3.rename(columns={'mean': 'churn_rate'}, inplace=True)
print(multi_group3)

# Interaction: Senior Citizen and Internet Service
print("\n[Multivariate] Churn Rate by Senior Citizen and Internet Service:")
multi_group4 = df.groupby(['SeniorCitizen', 'InternetService'])['Churn_numeric'].agg(['mean', 'count'])
multi_group4.rename(columns={'mean': 'churn_rate'}, inplace=True)
print(multi_group4)
print("-" * 40 + "\n")
